releaseNotes:
Fixed
• A game that has not been played can no longer be saved as finished. SportyBet reported one game as "ended, 0–0" eleven hours before its tip-off, and the app took it as the result. A final score is now refused when it gives a team 0 points, or when it arrives before, or within an hour of, the tip-off.
• A game saved with such a score is repaired at the next score refresh: the false score is removed, the game waits again and gets its real score after it is played. The message after the refresh names every game this happened to.
• A trial counts a game only after its tip-off has passed. The game that was counted too early goes back to "waiting" as soon as you open the trial.
• When SportyBet keeps giving a false score for a game that has been played, ESPN is asked instead. This needs the results source "SportyBet + ESPN Backup" in Settings.

New
• Check for update now only checks. When a new version is found you see what it brings: the fixes and features of every version you do not have yet, with the date and the download size.
• The download starts when you tap "Download and install". When it is done the Android installer opens by itself, as before.

New
• Check for update now only checks. When a new version is found you see what it brings: the fixes and features of every version you do not have yet, with the date and the download size.
• The download starts when you tap "Download and install". When it is done the Android installer opens by itself, as before.

New
• The live trial, game by game: under a model's yellow trial text a link opens a page with the games that count, the games waiting for a final score and the games left out, and what both versions projected and picked in each.
• A "Trials" page with every trial, and a "Trial ended" message when a trial reaches its verdict.
• Training queue: one model trains at a time; others wait in line and start by themselves.
• Scores for the games of a running trial are refreshed automatically (switch in Settings, "Trial games").
• Longer AI answers on OpenAI-style and Anthropic providers.
• SportyBet codes: no waiting time between codes.

Fixed
• Every trial check is saved with its time; a failed check is shown instead of hidden.
• A trial waits up to 36 hours for the score of an earlier game before it decides.

Fixed
• AI answers that were cut off: the app now says so instead of failing without a reason.
• When a provider refuses a request because of its quota, the provider's full message and the waiting time are shown.
• Crash reports can be decoded for every published version.
